learning_need: French-language specialist introduction to Egyptian hieroglyphic writing and contextual inscription reading
decision_rationale: The current History & Culture canon has strong broad-history, historical-method and classical-history routes but no direct Egyptology or ancient-writing-system course. This current 20-hour University of Liège/FUN route combines specialist expertise, structured progression, module-level self-assessment and strong accessibility in French. It does not displace the broad category leaders; it earns admission because the learning need and language coverage are materially distinct at a quality level above the bar.
marginal_value: Adds the first canonical Egyptology/hieroglyphic-literacy pathway and meaningful French-language specialist coverage, with applied reading practice absent from the existing History & Culture set.
provider_concentration_notes: FUN is already represented in History & Culture by a distinct cultural/music-history course; the subject roles do not overlap and provider concentration remains limited.
coverage_notes: Complements rather than replaces broad world history, historical method and Ancient Greek history. The narrow specialist scope is justified by unusually strong pedagogy, expertise and applied writing-system practice.
